periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 to 60 degree inward tilt toward the nasal bridge relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval morphology with a vertical major axis significantly exceeding the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the inferior pole extending significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a relatively flat profile across the spinal region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial thickness, occupying approximately 30% of the visible dorsal torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation between the pinnae bases, roughly twice the width of a single ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior margins of both ears.
